phase_name: Wire hard mode and the aux signals into orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh

objectives.description: Add --hard (default off) flag/usage; script-side of the caller threading
Call orchestrate-churn.sh when --hard, after status transition, before commit
Persist audit_requested/target/verbatim_goal to aux_pending[task] in the resolved defect_store
Emit base-mode drift-inspection aux signal below 70% phase completion
Emit blocker-research aux signal on verdict=blocked (mode-independent)
Extend output JSON with aux_signal informational field only

approaches_tried.approach: Placed the WORK (k) block after verdict resolution and before WORK (i)'s commit, rather than immediately after WORK (f)'s status transition, since the blocker-research signal needs the resolved verdict.
approaches_tried.reason: Task phrasing ('after status transition, before commit') is satisfied by any point in that range; verdict availability is required for the blocker signal.

deviations.description: thread it from orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's per-row hard mode through the caller
deviations.reason: orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh never calls orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh directly -- SKILL.md is the actual caller of both scripts, and threading --hard into SKILL.md's own postflight call sites is explicitly Phase 6's task ('Thread --hard into the Stage MT-4 postflight call so Phase 3's wiring is reachable'). This phase completes the script-side half (accepting and using --hard); the caller-side SKILL.md edit is deferred to Phase 6 per the plan's own dependency graph.
